Easter hymns in Tonic Solfa

Easter Day celebrates the resurrection of Jesus from the dead, and the Easter season runs on for fifty days to Pentecost. These are hymns of the empty tomb and the risen Lord. Here are the 8 hymns on NoteFusion, each with the solfa written under the words, staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

AdventChristmasEpiphanyLentHoly WeekGood FridayEasterAscensionHalloweenThanksgivingHoly CommunionEveningFuneral

    Doh is Eb3/4Tune: AUF, AUF, MEIN HERZ MIT FREUDENSolfa PDF

    Doh is C4/4Tune: CHRIST AROSESolfa PDF

    Doh is C4/4Tune: CHRIST LAG IN TOBES BANDENSolfa PDF

    Doh is D4/4Tune: DUKE STREETSolfa PDF

  • Jesus Christ Is Risen Today

    Jesus Christ is risen today, Alleluia!

    Doh is C4/4Tune: EASTER HYMNSolfa PDF

  • Jesus Christ Who Came to Save

    Jesus Christ, who came to save,

    Doh is C4/4Tune: JESUS CHRISTUS UNSER HEILAND, DER DEN TOD (KLUG)Solfa PDF
